page.marginRule: Equal on all four edges. A letter may open the frame wider than the résumé's 0.65in (0.7–0.8in reads as a formal letter) but it must stay EQUAL. Never shrink a single edge to win space.

contentBox.rule: At 0.7in margins the printable area is 11 - 1.4 = 9.6in tall. Content must fit inside it at its NATURAL height.

pageModel.printPage: .page { width: auto; height: auto; min-height: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
pageModel.rule: The sign-off FLOWS at the end of the body. It is NOT pinned.
⛔forbidden: height: <n>in on .page in print — @page{margin} already insets the printable area, so a .page that also declares a near-full height overflows the sheet
overflow: hidden on .page in print — combined with a height it CLIPS the sign-off instead of revealing the overflow
display:flex + margin-top:auto on .signoff — that is the RÉSUMÉ's pinned-footer model; on a letter it reserves a band the closing paragraph is pushed into
pageModel.why: Observed 2026-07-25 (Sony letter, shipped): the résumé pattern was copied onto a letter and 'Founder & CEO, Martian Games LLC' was sliced through the middle while the email line vanished. check_overflow reported overflowBy:0, check_generation passed 10/10, the page count was 1, and the clipped text still existed in the text layer. The defect existed ONLY in the rasterised PDF.

fitToOnePage.rule: A cover letter is EXACTLY 1 page and must never clip. When it does not fit, fix it in THIS order:
order: 1. CUT PROSE — remove the paragraph that duplicates the résumé or restates an earlier point. Best fix; the letter gets stronger.
2. TIGHTEN the closing — merge the final two paragraphs into one.
3. REDUCE body font-size in 0.25px steps within the allowed band (11.5px -> 11.0px -> 10.75px). Below 10.5px is unreadable in print.
4. REDUCE line-height within the band (1.55 -> 1.5 -> 1.45). Below 1.4 the paragraph reads cramped.
5. LAST RESORT: widen @page margin to 0.75in-0.8in (equal on all edges) — this REMOVES space, so it only helps if the body is short and the frame is what pushes the sign-off over.
⛔never: Never add a fixed height + overflow:hidden to 'make it fit' — that HIDES the overflow instead of fixing it, and ships a clipped document.
Never let the sign-off land alone on a second page (orphan signature) — unprofessional.
Never shrink one margin edge; margins stay equal.

guards: check_pagefit  ⭐ REQUIRED — asserts exactly 1 page, no ink clipped at the content edge, and no orphan sign-off
verifyByEye: Rasterise and LOOK at the bottom 15% of the page (`pdf_to_png`). A DOM-based guard cannot see a renderer clip — that is exactly how the 2026-07-25 defect shipped.
bestFor: Every cover letter. Counterpart to two-page-standard.json (résumé / work-samples), which DOES pin its footer because its page count is fixed.
